name: cody-codex-coordinator
description: Turn one Codex task into a durable repository root with visible, bounded orchestration and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate, route, and recover repository work.
interface.longDescription: Cody establishes one durable repository root, keeps Sol as the judgment and release owner, routes class-level work and review to Terra, routes routine operations and deterministic proof to Luna, preserves checkpoints, and recovers interrupted work without making the project owner relay messages.
defaultPrompt: Use $cody-codex-coordinator:cody-coordinator to make this task the repository root and report verified status.
Use $cody-codex-coordinator:cody-coordinator to coordinate this repository outcome through visible bounded tasks.
Use $cody-codex-coordinator:cody-coordinator to recover this interrupted repository task.
